lane.description: Verify the supplier for a delivery: confirm the contact on the paperwork matches the supplier record, check the supplier is active, and record the check. One run per supplier. A supplier that is not active ends the run as held.
lane.name: Supplier Check

fields.description: Contact name confirmed at step 1.1, checked against the supplier record.
Set to 'verified' when the check completes at step 2.1.

steps.description: Confirm the contact on the delivery paperwork matches the supplier record: Kiln & Clay Co.'s contact is Priya Nair.
steps.name: Confirm the supplier contact

validation.message: Contact name must match the supplier record.

steps.description: Automatic check: the supplier is active. A supplier that is not active ends the run as held.
steps.name: Supplier is active

steps.description: Record that the supplier check is complete. The check result is stored in the run data.
steps.name: Mark the supplier check complete
